export interface EquipmentClassPropertiesPayload {
  equipmentClassId: number
  properties: Record<string, unknown>
}

export interface CreateEquipmentWithDetailsDto {
  classIds?: Array<number>
  classProperties?: Array<EquipmentClassPropertiesPayload>
  code?: string
  description?: string
  equipmentLevelId: number
  erpSource?: string
  parentEquipmentId?: number | null
  plant?: number
  properties?: Record<string, unknown>
  propertiesEquipmentClassId?: number
  sapObjId?: number
}

// Represents an enriched property with semantic metadata
export interface Isa95EnrichedPropertyDto {
  id?: number
  code: string
  value?: string | number | null
  propertySemanticsJson?: Record<string, unknown> | null
  isCustom?: boolean
  propertyDataTypeId?: number
  equipmentClassId?: number
  parentEquipmentClassPropertyId?: number | null
  length?: number | null
  scale?: number | null
  createdAt?: string
  updatedAt?: string
}

export interface Isa95EquipmentByClassPropertyDto {
  id: number
  equipmentClassId: number
  propertiesJson: Record<string, unknown>
}

export interface Isa95EquipmentByClassDto {
  id: number
  plant: number
  code: string
  description: string
  descriptionLanguageCode?: string
  parentEquipmentId: number | null
  equipmentLevelId: number
  equipmentLevelCode?: string
  properties: Array<Isa95EquipmentByClassPropertyDto>
}

import type { Isa95PropertyDataTypeDto } from './isa95-property-data-type-dto';

export interface Isa95EquipmentClassPropertySemanticsDto {
  cardinality?: string | null
  classPropertyType?: string | null
  defaultValue?: string | null
}

// Complete DTO for equipment class property definitions from backend
export interface Isa95EquipmentClassPropertyDto {
  id: number
  code: string
  description: string | null
  propertySemanticsJson?: Isa95EquipmentClassPropertySemanticsDto | null
  equipmentClassId: number
  propertyDataTypeId: number
  propertyDataType?: Isa95PropertyDataTypeDto | null
  isCustom: boolean
  defaultValue: string | null
  cardinality?: string | null
  classPropertyType?: string | null
  allowedValues: string | null
  length: number | null
  scale: number | null
  parentEquipmentClassPropertyId: number | null
}

// Flat denormalized row returned by the getHierarchyDetailsFlat endpoint.
// One equipment may appear in multiple rows when it has multiple classes or property records.
export interface Isa95HierarchyFlatRowDto {
  classCode: string | null
  classId: number | null
  classIsCustom: boolean | null
  code: string
  descriptionByLanguage: string | null
  descriptionLanguageCode: string | null
  equipmentLevelCode: string
  equipmentLevelId: number
  erpSource: string
  id: number
  parentEquipmentId: number | null
  plant: string
  propertiesJson: Record<string, unknown> | string | null
  propertyId: number | null
  sapObjId: number
}

// State for a property form (create / edit panel)
export interface PropertyFormState {
  allowedValues: string | undefined
  cardinality: 'single' | 'array' | undefined
  classPropertyType: string | undefined
  code: string
  defaultValue: string | undefined
  description: string | undefined
  equipmentClassId: number | undefined
  length: number | undefined
  propertyDataTypeId: number | undefined
  scale: number | undefined
}

name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  - template: jobs/sonar-process.yml@pipelines
    parameters:
      prepare_scanner_mode: CLI
      prepare_sonarExclusions: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/node_modules/**
      prepare_sonarAdditionalProperties: |
        sonar.sources=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.test.inclusions=**/*.spec.ts
        sonar.tests=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/src
        sonar.typescript.tsconfigPath=$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/tsconfig.lint.json

      step_postPrepare:
        - template: steps/angular-lint-and-test.yaml@pipelines
          parameters:
            nodejs_version: 22.x
            run_unit_tests: false

        - template: steps/sonarqube-reports.yml@pipelines
          parameters:
            reports:
              - name: sonar.junit.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/junit-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.eslint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/report.json
              - name: sonar.testExecutionReportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/sonar-tests.xml
              - name: sonar.flex.cobertura.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml
              - name: sonar.javascript.lcov.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/coverage/lcov.info
              - name: sonar.css.stylelint.reportPaths
                path: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/stylelint.json

# base stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/httpd:2.4 AS base

EXPOSE 3000

# build stage
FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/node:22 AS build

ARG DEBUG_BUILD="false"

ENV NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt"

COPY --from=acrprdfaurecia001.azurecr.io/cloud/azure/ca-certificates:latest \
  /ca-certificates.crt \
  /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

WORKDIR /app

COPY . .

## DEBUG_BUILD is initialized with a lowercase value
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npmrc,target=/root/.npmrc npm install \
    && npm run build:meta-env-bin \
    && DEBUG_BUILD=$(echo ${DEBUG_BUILD} | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') \ 
    && npm run build -- --sourcemap $DEBUG_BUILD

FROM base AS runtime

COPY --from=build /app/web-server-config/httpd.conf /usr/local/apache2/conf/httpd.conf

COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/local/apache2/htdocs/

COPY --from=build /app/web-server-config/.htaccess /usr/local/apache2/htdocs/.htaccess

COPY --from=build /app/import-meta-env /app/

COPY --from=build /app/.env.dist /app/.env.dist

COPY --from=build /app/start.sh /app/start.sh

RUN adduser --system httpd --gid 0 \
  && chown -R httpd:root /usr/local/apache2 \
  && chown -R httpd:root /app

USER httpd

CMD ["/bin/sh", "-c", "/app/start.sh"]

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
    type: git
    name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  tags:
    include:
    - '*'
  branches:
    include:
    - main
    - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
    - README.md

parameters:
- name: isDebugBuild
  displayName: 'Build in DEBUG Mode'
  type: boolean
  default: false

variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: hry-set-ui

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - template: test/jobs/jobs-node-static-tests.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      auditLevel: 'critical'

  - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
      debugBuild: ${{ parameters.isDebugBuild }}
      repository: mesx/plant-hierarchy-setup-ui

- stage: Dev
  condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
  jobs:
  - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
    parameters:
      azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
      pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
      containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
      containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01
